rows.ticket: Will I pay extra if I use my data in France on holiday?
rows.answer: No extra charge applies for data in France, as it is in the EU, so it costs the same as at home. On the Unlimited plan, fair use for roaming data is 30 GB per month. Make sure roaming is enabled under Services > Roaming in the app.

rows.ticket: I have the Unlimited plan. How much data can I use while roaming in Italy?
rows.answer: Italy is in the EU, so roaming costs the same as at home. On the Unlimited plan, fair use for roaming data is 30 GB per month. Roaming must be enabled under Services > Roaming in the app.

rows.ticket: How do I set up an eSIM and how long does it take?
rows.answer: Open the app, go to SIM > Get eSIM and scan the QR code. Your phone needs a Wi-Fi connection during setup. Activation takes up to 15 minutes, and the eSIM is free of charge.

rows.ticket: I lost my SIM card. How much is a new one and when will it arrive?
rows.answer: Sorry to hear you lost your SIM. A replacement physical SIM costs 5 euros and arrives within 3 working days. Order it in the app under SIM > Replace. Your old SIM stops working once the new one is activated.

rows.ticket: My phone is asking for a PUK code, where do I find it?
rows.answer: Your phone asks for a PUK code, which you can find in the Nimbo Mobile app under SIM > PUK. Note that after 10 wrong PUK attempts the SIM is blocked permanently and must be replaced.

rows.ticket: What day do you charge my bank account for the invoice?
rows.answer: Direct debit is charged on day 5 of each month. Invoices are issued on day 1 of the month. If an invoice is unpaid after 14 days, a late payment fee of 6 euros applies.

rows.ticket: What happens if I pay my bill late?
rows.answer: If an invoice is unpaid after 14 days, a late payment fee of 6 euros applies. Invoices are issued on day 1 of each month, and direct debit is charged on day 5. If you have questions about your specific account balance, our team can help you further.

rows.ticket: I got a new bank card, how can I update my payment details?
rows.answer: You can update your bank card in the Nimbo app under Billing > Payment method. Changes made before day 28 of the month apply to your next invoice.

rows.ticket: If I move to a cheaper plan, when does it start?
rows.answer: Downgrades to a cheaper plan take effect from your next billing cycle. You can change your plan for free once per month in the app under Plan > Change.

rows.ticket: How much does it cost to buy 20 GB more data?
rows.answer: A 20 GB extra data top-up costs 12 euros. It lasts until the end of your billing cycle, and unused data does not roll over to the next cycle.

rows.ticket: Does leftover top-up data carry over to next month?
rows.answer: No, leftover top-up data does not carry over. Top-ups last until the end of the billing cycle, and unused data does not roll over to the next month. For example, a 5 GB top-up costs 5 euros and a 20 GB top-up costs 12 euros.

rows.ticket: How long does it take to bring my phone number from my current provider?
rows.answer: Bringing your number from another operator (number portability) takes 1 working day. The account holder must request it with a valid ID. Service may be interrupted for up to 2 hours on the switch day.

rows.ticket: Can I change my fibre installation appointment? It is in three days.
rows.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your fibre installation for free up to 24 hours before the visit. Changes made later cost 30 euros, so please reschedule before then if you need to move it.

rows.ticket: There is no internet and the LOS light on my router is red.
rows.answer: Sorry about the outage. A red LOS light means there is a line fault. Please open an incident in the app under Support > Fibre. Line faults are repaired within 24 hours. Before that, try unplugging your router for 30 seconds to restart it.

rows.ticket: My wifi is really slow in the bedroom, what can I try?
rows.answer: Thanks for reaching out. To improve Wi-Fi in the bedroom, try placing the router in a central, open location. Stay on the 5 GHz network when you're close to the router, and use the 2.4 GHz network for longer range, such as in the bedroom. If it's still slow, test your speed with a cable before we open an incident.

rows.ticket: I financed a phone. What do I owe if I leave before the 24 months?
rows.answer: If you leave before the 24 months, the remaining instalments of your financed device become payable. Your mobile line itself has no minimum contract, so you are not bound to it beyond the device plan.

rows.ticket: My insured phone was stolen yesterday. How do I claim and how much will I pay?
rows.answer: Sorry to hear your phone was stolen. You can file your claim in the app under Insurance. Claims must be filed within 48 hours of the incident, so since the theft was yesterday, please file today. Each claim has an excess of 49 euros, which is what you will pay.

rows.ticket: How many lines fit on a family plan and what is the discount?
rows.answer: A Nimbo family plan covers up to 5 lines on one invoice. Each additional line after the first gets a 20 percent discount.

rows.ticket: Is 5G more expensive on my plan?
rows.answer: No, 5G is included in all Nimbo Mobile plans at no extra cost. You need a 5G-compatible phone and to be in a covered area. You can check coverage on the map in the app under Network.

rows.ticket: How long until an approved refund reaches my bank?
rows.answer: Approved refunds reach your bank within 5 working days. Refunds are returned to the original payment method.

rows.ticket: How do I stop premium-rate SMS on my line?
rows.answer: You can block premium-rate calls and SMS for free in the app. Go to Services > Restrictions and turn on the premium-number block. The change applies within 1 hour.

rows.ticket: What does a call to Germany from Spain cost per minute?
rows.answer: A call from Spain to Germany costs 0.12 euros per minute, since Germany is another EU country. If you want 200 minutes of calls to other EU countries, you can add the International Bundle for 6 euros per month. Let us know if you need anything else.
